content: refinery 0.9.2 (Jun 2026) remains the standalone migration runner for rusqlite with embed_migrations!; workspace uses 0.8.16 for the main DB only while the two memory DBs use unversioned CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. Upgrade to 0.9.x and extend refinery to all three SQLite files; do not adopt sqlx (would mean replacing rusqlite wholesale for no async need).
